main_text.p: Sublato fundamento non durat relatio42. Nona, in relationibus moralibus, imò & in omnibus relationibus sublato fundamento non durae relatio, veluti[?] gratia relatio domini ad servum bello captum non manet servo vendito, quia perit fundamentum per venditionem, tunc enim haud habet Dominus potestatem eo amplius utendi pro libitu: Item perit relatio ducis ad militem militiâ absolutâ, quia perit fundamentum; tunc enim dux non habet potestatem imperandi militi; at verò disciplinâ confectâ manet relatio præceptoris ad discipulum disputari solet; Ad hoc respondeo distinctione, si enim discipulus aliquid didicit, tunc relatio manet, eò quòd fundamentum scilicet disciplina manet, si verò nihil didicit, vel si postquam didicit non retinet, perit relatio, quia perit fundamentum, sublato autem fundamento tolluntur ejusmodi relationes.

p.i: Plura de Relatione juxta meam sententiam tradam Deo juvante disputatione singulari de Relatione, ubi fusè agam de Relationibus Divinis.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament at the centre bottom (a winged face with scrolled tails) is an engraving and is not transcribed. The Google watermark at the bottom right is excluded. Doubtful readings: "veluti" (the scan is faint and could read differently) and "durae" (the margin note reads "durat"; the main text may read "durat" as well). Ink smudges and show-through are excluded.
